summary: Verified participant SEO admin fallback preview feature. All 5 scenarios PASS. Admin opens participant edit form and immediately shows fallback SEO preview generated by buildFallbackSeo() — identical char-by-char to what public page renders when no DB record exists. Closing form without Save does NOT create a DB record. Explicit Save persists custom SEO. Autofill button regenerates fallback correctly. Other participants (Александр Шепс, Виктория Райдос) show correct achievements from p.title.

scenario_1_no_db_record_fallback_preview.details: Elena Golunova: title='Елена Голунова — Финалистка 13 сезона «Битвы экстрасенсов» | Битва Экстрасенсов', desc starts with 'Елена Голунова — Финалистка 13 сезона', h1='Елена Голунова', og_title starts with 'Елена Голунова — Финалистка 13 сезона'. After closing form without save: SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE page_slug='participant-elena-golunova' = 0 (DB unchanged).

scenario_2_save_persistence.details: Saved title with 'МОЁ:' prefix. mysql confirmed record exists. Reopened form shows saved 'МОЁ:...' (not fallback). Cleanup DELETE executed — DB restored to 0 participant-* records.

scenario_3_admin_public_char_by_char.details: After cleanup (no DB record), public /uchastniki/elena-golunova document.title and meta[name=description] match admin fallback preview values EXACTLY char-by-char (single generator buildFallbackSeo).

scenario_4_autofill_button.details: Clearing SEO title then clicking 'Заполнить автоматически' produces title identical to initial fallback.

scenario_5_other_participants.details: Александр Шепс → title contains 'Победитель 14', h1='Александр Шепс'. Виктория Райдос → title contains 'Победительница 16', h1='Виктория Райдос'.

critical_code_review_comments: ParticipantsAdmin.js openEdit — logic is correct and idempotent; the `if (d && d.id)` guard is the correct signal that record exists (GET /api/seo/:slug without record returns object without id).
buildFallbackSeo is a pure function and correctly reused in both admin preview + autofill button + public page fallback — single source of truth. Good design.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created seo_settings row with title starting 'МОЁ:' for scenario 2, then deleted via `DELETE FROM seo_settings WHERE page_slug='participant-elena-golunova' AND title LIKE 'МОЁ:%'`. Final DB state: 0 participant-* records (original state restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working. Admin fallback preview matches public fallback char-by-char. DB stays clean until user explicitly clicks Save. GET /api/seo/:slug returns object WITHOUT `id` field when no record exists — this is the signal admin uses to distinguish preview vs. persisted values.
